title: link_event never coalesces, so repeated install failures can evict the terminal cause the history keeps
outcome: Consecutive identical install failures coalesce with a count, as the durability history's refusal() does, so a long hold with repeated attempts cannot rotate out the first terminal record. Source: Claude session-17028 review of a06f2c92, src/federation_link_diagnostics.rs:376. Eviction is visible today through linkEventsEvicted; the real retry cadence wasn't established.
